task: Bind early trusted release executor steps to the existing exact-error diagnostic and Failure Intake, including fail-closed stage localization for unavailable early errors.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Even after merged #1180, Release Unit Execution pre-drive dependency install, source fetch, Knowledge/Atlas, Plan and Risk command failures occur before the wrapped driver and are reported only as a generic RELEASE_UNIT_EXECUTION_FAILED. Preserve their original precise command error, causal step, SHA and job metadata automatically without bypassing authority, retrying release, or claiming unavailable root cause.
observableOutcomes: Every executable trusted release pre-drive command is wrapped with the shared streamed command diagnostic, with distinct stage ID, output and fallback code.
The existing job-local Failure Intake collects all stage diagnostics from exactly this run and keeps the precise code/reason/evidence when available, not just generic release failure.
Unexpected GitHub action/setup failure before wrapper execution is reported as structured UNKNOWN/root-cause-not-captured with failed GitHub step identity; no fabricated exact error.
Representative simulated npm/install, source fetch and knowledge/risk faults preserve child nonzero status, secret redaction and precise stage localization, and successful steps remain PASS.
Exact-head CI guards and main merge proof remain mandatory; no rerun of an existing release transaction.
unresolvedRisks: Error in GitHub checkout before repository scripts are available cannot have a valid exact raw code from command wrapper; mark UNKNOWN instead of inventing.
`npm ci` dependency install must remain fail-closed even before lockfile modules are available; diagnostic uses Node core only.
Source-plan extraction pipeline must retain git SHA verification and exact output path, including no stale/source-injection acceptance.
All stage artifacts may contain sanitized command errors but raw CI token-bearing stdout is still console/logged; masked by runner; do not copy raw secrets to artifact.
Workflow `if: failure()` can run after any earlier failed step, but its intake script may itself be absent after checkout failure; never claim complete coverage for impossible path.
Generic Failure Intake must not misclassify skipped or successful stage artifacts as a failed gate.
Raw shared wrapper may report machine fallback for non-structured npm/git errors; preserve raw text and label fallback truthfully.

in: Change only `.github/workflows/release-unit-execution.yml` to invoke existing shared `scripts/shoperation-command-diagnostic.mjs` for install, exact source fetch, Knowledge/Atlas, Plan Before Code, Release Risk and git identity step, each with distinct machine code, stage name and output.
Keep existing `Drive canonical release-unit execution` as-is and extend job-local Failure Intake/Artifact upload to include all stage JSON files.
Provide early-action fallback summary diagnostic only when command artifacts are missing, without falsely claiming the root cause; never weaken GitHub action errors.
Add targeted tests to `tests/control-plane-diagnostic-coverage.test.ts`, including exact pre-drive stage wiring and a simulated failure boundary demonstrating stage/exit/code/source plus redaction.
out: No edit to scripts/release-unit-execute.mjs or canonical release-state branches/receipts.
No mutation of `scripts/shoperation-command-diagnostic.mjs` or `scripts/shoperation-failure-intake.mjs` unless new plan gate proves a true necessity and revised scope.
No edits to CI/Template Factory /fresh install /checkout action contracts, feature runtime, storefront, authentication, payment, database or prod deployment.
No bypass of Knowledge, Plan, Risk, Edit-Time, Truth, Lifecycle or release gate/merge thresholds.
No automated child release rehearsal or duplicate Vercel builds.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: An executor pre-drive failure is release-authoritative, so staging/fallback must preserve nonzero and no false completion or exact-code overclaims.

acceptanceCriteria: Pre-drive trust steps keep exact source verification, Knowledge, Plan, Risk and identity semantics; exact success behavior unchanged.
When any covered pre-drive step fails, a distinct stage-specific diagnostic JSON captures original child failure code where present, redacted reason and source/run; workflow fails.
On pre-script checkout/setup failure, no fake exact code is emitted; the available step-outcome localization/fallback remains truthful and non-green.
Existing Failure Intake ingests all stage JSON and driver JSON into the same canonical report, with no duplicate standalone engine.
Regression tests cover original exit code, stage code, error redaction, and expected workflow bindings.
Plan Before Code, Edit-Time, Incremental Replay, release risk, full tests, TypeScript, production build, Completion Truth and lifecycle all PASS for the exact implementation SHA.
invariants: Release executor admission and source provenance remain unchanged.
Stage diagnostic wrapper cannot convert a command failure to PASS or retry it.
Only actual JSON artifacts are used as concrete exact-code proof; missing artifacts are UNKNOWN.
Each stage artifact is assigned a stable gateCode and exact associated command.
No state mutation takes place in the diagnostic postflight/Failure Intake.
Observed child exit/status remains authoritative for CI and persisted state.
forbiddenStates: GitHub raw checkout failure is labeled with a made-up exact root cause.
A failed npm install is swallowed as a passing prereq.
`git show` invalid source writes a supposedly valid immutable source plan or proceeds to driver.
A blocked Knowledge/Plan/Risk preflight is treated as successful.
A failed command causes a fresh release run/branch/PR as a diagnostic side effect.
Tokens are stored unredacted in release diagnostics or Failure Intake.
Edit-Time Reference Sync is bypassed to satisfy gate.

failureModes: Checkout failed before repo scripts available.
Dependency install missing package/lock or npm transient network issue.
Source ref absent, invalid SHA, or git show fails.
Knowledge/Atlas preflight blocks, could leave artifact.
Plan Before Code denies forged/broadened plan.
Drive fails with nested RELEASE_UNIT_EXECUTION_BLOCK; existing #1180 handles it.
Failure Intake parser may not understand absent diagnostic artifact and use generic code.
edgeCases: Only the active run's SHA must label emitted artifacts.
Skipped pre-drive stage should not be classified as FAIL.
npm stderr contains uppercase error tokens, exact machine code available only when truly in output.
Early exit before artifact generation yields explicit UNKNOWN and failed step ID.
Job-level failure remains red even if reporting step succeeds.
Github repository checkout failure makes local script missing; cannot claim impossible artifact.
Running actor/token remains workflow-scoped; no new Action permissions.

alternatives.summary: Reuse canonical command diagnostic around existing pre-drive commands and extend current job-local intake.
alternatives.reason: Covers command failures in same workflow with stable code and no additional execution authority.

alternatives.summary: Replace full release workflow with new master CLI and installer/handler.
alternatives.reason: Introduces duplicate execution authority and breaks trusted workflow_run admission.

alternatives.summary: Poll full GitHub job logs to infer a missing root cause, even before checkout.
alternatives.reason: Sensitive, eventual-consistency prone and risks confusing diagnostic text with trusted evidence.

specialistReviews.finding: Shared command diagnostic exists; failures occur earlier than its current driver-only use.
specialistReviews.resolution: Wrap existing pre-drive commands in same producer, collect stage artifacts via existing Failure Intake.

specialistReviews.finding: GitHub secrets or bare shell error may leak into persistent artifacts or a misleading PASS, especially before dependency setup.
specialistReviews.resolution: No secret values in workflow arguments, use existing sanitized bounded wrapper, fail closed, do not produce exact claim if code unavailable.

specialistReviews.finding: Diagnostic wrapper must not rerun release side effects, shift source SHA or skip original Knowledge/Plan/Risk trust checks.
specialistReviews.resolution: Pre-drive command-only wrapping with original command content and unchanged driver invocation; no replay or new branch.

specialistReviews.finding: Every new failure artifact needs a distinct gateCode, and absent precheckout error is unknown rather than a fake code.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use existing Failure Intake with stage-scoped JSON and explicit missing-artifact step fallback.

challenge.scenario: npm ci exits 1 before dependencies exist.
challenge.finding: Third-party helper cannot run before install.
challenge.resolution: Existing diagnostic is Node core-only and can wrap npm before installing modules.

challenge.scenario: Checkout fails and no tracked repository script is present.
challenge.finding: An exact command wrapper cannot be executed.
challenge.resolution: Record available GitHub step outcome only, label root cause unavailable, do not falsely certify exact source.

challenge.scenario: Source SHA invalid or source plan missing.
challenge.resolution: Keep git fetch/rev-parse/git show in `set -euo pipefail` and preserve exit through wrapper.

challenge.scenario: Knowledge preflight blocks with structured error.
challenge.finding: Old driver-only reporting loses actual code.
challenge.resolution: New per-stage diagnostics retain output and corresponding gate artifacts through current Failure Intake.

challenge.scenario: Failed stage makes later stages skipped.
challenge.finding: Generic intake could misattribute skipped stages.
challenge.resolution: Feed only existing artifacts; fallback reports first failed step and never assumes missing stages ran.

challenge.scenario: Failure Intake itself fails after gate failure.
challenge.resolution: Keep reporting conditional/after failed command, never override original nonzero status, archive diagnostics via independent upload.

challenge.scenario: GH_TOKEN appears in a nested error.
challenge.finding: Stored evidence can leak sensitive token.
challenge.resolution: Use shared sanitizer, keep raw error only redacted and fail if test sees token.

challenge.scenario: Target GitHub SHA drifts between source CI and trusted executor.
challenge.resolution: No change to immutable SHA check, no source branch inference, no force push.

challenge.scenario: Simple shell Git stderr has no stable uppercase machine code.
challenge.finding: Fallback code is not truly exact Git root cause.
challenge.resolution: Explicit fallback code with original sanitized stderr; never assert exact root-cause proven.

proofPlan: Plan-only exact-head CI must show Plan Before Code PASS before editing implementation files.
Wrap early release authoritative commands with distinct diagnostic gates and bounded JSON artifacts, preserving nonzero.
Run focused tests demonstrating exact/non-exact source and npm failures, failure-intake wiring and positive passes.
Run Knowledge, Plan, Edit-Time, Incremental, Risk, full quality, TypeScript, production build, Truth and Lifecycle on exact head; fix failures without weakening.
Use emitted CI-owned closure artifact byte-exact; merge only with successful latest SHA and verify exact new main CI.
Leave #1018 open for separate external-proof and universal early job pre-checkout scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Release pre-drive command errors yield stage-specific machine diagnostics before driver, preserving original fail-closed outcome.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Early errors cannot become a passing driver result.

requirements.requirement: Failure Intake and run summary identify the first failed pre-drive stage, source/run and available original evidence without inventing unavailable checkout details.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Uncaptured early checkout failures cannot be claimed as exact known root cause.

requirements.requirement: Release risk and source trust remain unchanged; no new authority, retry, state mutation or release dispatch.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No release-risk or source trust bypass.

notes: Plan-only checkpoint; no implementation edits before exact-head Plan Before Code PASS.
Issue #1018 PARTIAL. Focus on the trusted release executor's pre-drive steps only; do not promise universal external-proof or pre-checkout raw-log coverage.
Reuse existing shoperation-command-diagnostic.mjs and shoperation-failure-intake.mjs; do not build a new parallel engine.
